words.word: A bad beginning makes a bad ending.
words.urdu: آغاز بد انجام بد
words.meaning: A bad start usually leads to a bad result.

words.word: A bad workman always quarrels with his tools.
words.urdu: ناچ نہ جانے آنگن ٹیڑھا
words.meaning: A poor worker blames his tools instead of himself.

words.word: A bird in hand is worth two in the bush.
words.urdu: نو نقد نہ تیرہ ادھار
words.meaning: What you already have is worth more than what you might get later.

words.word: A bribe will enter without knocking.
words.urdu: رشوت ہر جگہ راستہ بنا لیتی ہے
words.meaning: Bribery can open any door.

words.word: A burnt child dreads the fire.
words.urdu: دودھ کا جلا چھاچھ بھی پھونک پھونک کر پیتا ہے
words.meaning: A person who has been hurt once becomes very careful.

words.word: A clear conscience is a coat of mail.
words.urdu: صاف ضمیر بہترین زرہ بکتر ہے
words.meaning: A clear conscience protects a person from fear.

words.word: A constant guest is never welcome.
words.urdu: روز کا مہمان بالائے جان
words.meaning: A visitor who comes too often loses his welcome.

words.word: A contented mind is a continual feast.
words.urdu: قناعت سب سے بڑی دولت ہے
words.meaning: Contentment is the greatest wealth.

words.word: A covetous man is never satisfied.
words.urdu: لالچی کا کبھی پیٹ نہیں بھرتا
words.meaning: A greedy person never has enough.

words.word: A crown is no cure for the headache.
words.urdu: دولت سے دکھ دور نہیں ہوتا
words.meaning: Wealth cannot remove all worries.

words.word: A danger foreseen is half avoided.
words.urdu: پیش بندی سے خطرہ ٹل جاتا ہے
words.meaning: A danger you know about is easier to avoid.

words.word: A disease known is half cured.
words.urdu: مرض کی تشخیص کو آدھا علاج سمجھنا چاہیے
words.meaning: Knowing the problem is half the solution.

words.word: A drowning man catches at a straw.
words.urdu: ڈوبتے کو تنکے کا سہارا
words.meaning: A desperate person grasps at any small hope.

words.word: A fair face may hide a foul heart.
words.urdu: شکل مومن کا کرتوت کافر
words.meaning: A pleasant face may hide evil intentions.

words.word: A fault confessed is half redressed.
words.urdu: اقرار جرم اصلاح جرم
words.meaning: Admitting a fault is half the correction.

words.word: A fool and his money are soon parted.
words.urdu: احمق کی دولت کو ٹکاؤ کہاں
words.meaning: A foolish person wastes money quickly.

words.word: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
words.urdu: دوست وہ جو مصیبت میں کام آئے
words.meaning: A true friend helps you in trouble.

words.word: A friend is another self.
words.urdu: دوست گویا اپنی ہی ذات کا پرتو ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: A true friend is like a second self.

words.word: A friend is easier lost than found.
words.urdu: دوست گنوانا سہل حاصل کرنا مشکل
words.meaning: Friends are easier to lose than to gain.

words.word: A friend to everybody is a friend to nobody.
words.urdu: جو شخص سب کا دوست ہے اسے کسی کا دوست نہ سمجھو
words.meaning: Trying to please everyone means pleasing no one.

words.word: A friend's frown is better than a fool's smile.
words.urdu: دوست کی ناراضگی دشمن کی مسکراہٹ سے بہتر ہے
words.meaning: Honest criticism from a friend is better than flattery.

words.word: A golden key opens every lock.
words.urdu: سونے کی چابی سے ہر تالا کھل جاتا ہے
words.meaning: Money opens every door.

words.word: A good beginning is half the battle.
words.urdu: نیک آغاز نصف فتح ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: A good start makes success much easier.

words.word: A good name is better than riches.
words.urdu: جائے لاکھ رہے ساکھ
words.meaning: A good reputation is worth more than wealth.

words.word: A good name is sooner lost than won.
words.urdu: نیک نامی گنوانا سہل حصول مشکل
words.meaning: Reputation is hard to earn and easy to lose.

words.word: A good tongue is a good weapon.
words.urdu: زبان شیریں ملک گیری
words.meaning: A sweet tongue can win anything.

words.word: A hedge between keeps friendship green.
words.urdu: باڑ سے دوستی میں فرق نہیں آنے پاتا
words.meaning: Keeping some distance preserves friendship.

words.word: A honey tongue, a heart of gall.
words.urdu: زبان پر شہد دل میں زہر
words.meaning: Sweet words may hide a bitter heart.

words.word: A hungry man is an angry man.
words.urdu: بھوکا سو روکھا
words.meaning: A hungry person is easily angered.

words.word: A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
words.urdu: بڑے بڑے کاموں کا آغاز بھی بہت چھوٹا ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Every great achievement starts with a small beginning.

words.word: A little knowledge is a dangerous thing.
words.urdu: نیم حکیم خطرہ جان
words.meaning: Knowing a little without full understanding can mislead.

words.word: A little leak will sink a great ship.
words.urdu: تھوڑی بد احتیاطی بڑا نقصان کرتی ہے
words.meaning: Small neglect can cause great loss.

words.word: A man can die but once.
words.urdu: موت ایک ہی بار آ سکتی ہے
words.meaning: Fear of death should not stop you from acting bravely.

words.word: A man in debt is caught in a net.
words.urdu: قرض کے دام سے نکلنا مشکل ہے
words.meaning: Debt traps a person.

words.word: A man is known by the company he keeps.
words.urdu: آدمی اپنی صحبت سے پہچانا جاتا ہے
words.meaning: Your friends show what kind of person you are.

words.word: A man's house is his castle.
words.urdu: اپنا گھر قلعہ
words.meaning: A person's home is his safe refuge.

words.word: A new broom sweeps clean.
words.urdu: نیا نوکر مارے ہرن
words.meaning: A newly appointed person makes big changes.

words.word: A penny saved is a penny earned.
words.urdu: بچایا سو کمایا
words.meaning: Saving money is as good as earning it.

words.word: A promise delayed is justice deferred.
words.urdu: وعدہ پورا کرنے میں دیر کرنا ناانصافی ہے
words.meaning: Delaying a promise is a kind of injustice.

words.word: A promise neglected is an untruth told.
words.urdu: وعدہ خلافی کرنا اور جھوٹ بولنا برابر
words.meaning: A broken promise is as bad as telling a lie.

words.word: A prophet is not honoured in his own country.
words.urdu: گھر کا جوگی جوگنا باہر کا جوگی سدھ
words.meaning: A person's worth is often unrecognized at home.

words.word: A quiet conscience sleeps in thunder.
words.urdu: صاف ضمیر کو کس کا ڈر
words.meaning: A clear conscience fears nothing.

words.word: A quiet tongue shows a wise head.
words.urdu: کم گوئی دانائی کی علامت ہے
words.meaning: A wise person speaks little.

words.word: A reconciled friend is a double enemy.
words.urdu: ایک بار جو دشمنی کرے اس کا اعتبار نہ کرو
words.meaning: Someone once your enemy can never be fully trusted.

words.word: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
words.urdu: دھوبی کا کتا گھر کا نہ گھاٹ کا
words.meaning: A person who keeps moving gains nothing lasting.

words.word: A single sinner sinks the boat.
words.urdu: ایک مچھلی سارے جال کو گندا کرتی ہے
words.meaning: One bad member can ruin the whole group.

words.word: A soft answer turns away wrath.
words.urdu: ٹھنڈا لوہا گرم لوہے کو کاٹتا ہے
words.meaning: A gentle reply calms anger.

words.word: A sound mind in a sound body.
words.urdu: قوی دماغ مضبوط جسم میں ہی رہ سکتا ہے
words.meaning: A healthy mind lives in a healthy body.

words.word: A stitch in time saves nine.
words.urdu: وقت کا ایک ٹانکا بے وقت کے سو ٹانکوں سے بچاتا ہے
words.meaning: Fixing a small problem early prevents a bigger one.

words.word: A stumble may prevent a fall.
words.urdu: آدمی وہ ہے جو ٹھوکر کھا کر سنبھل جائے
words.meaning: A small mistake can teach you to avoid a bigger one.

words.word: A thief is certainly caught at last.
words.urdu: سو دن چور کے ایک دن شاہ کا
words.meaning: A thief is caught in the end.

words.word: A tree is known by its fruit.
words.urdu: درخت اپنے پھل سے پہچانا جاتا ہے
words.meaning: A person is judged by his results.

words.word: A wise enemy is better than a foolish friend.
words.urdu: نادان دوست سے دانا دشمن بھلا
words.meaning: Better an honest enemy than a foolish friend.

words.word: A wise man gets learning from those who have none themselves.
words.urdu: عقلمند بیوقوفوں کے تجربہ سے سیکھتا ہے
words.meaning: The wise learn even from the mistakes of fools.

words.word: A word and a stone let go cannot be recalled.
words.urdu: زبان سے نکلی بات اور کمان سے نکلا تیر واپس نہیں آتے
words.meaning: Spoken words, like thrown stones, cannot be taken back.

words.word: A word out of season may mar the course of a whole life.
words.urdu: بے محل بات بہت نقصان دہ ثابت ہو سکتی ہے
words.meaning: An ill-timed word can cause great harm.

words.word: A word to the wise is enough.
words.urdu: عقلمند کو اشارہ کافی ہے
words.meaning: A wise person needs only a hint.

words.word: A work begun is half done.
words.urdu: کام شروع کرنا ہی مشکل ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Starting a task is the hardest part.

words.word: A workman is known by his work.
words.urdu: کاریگر کام سے پہچانا جاتا ہے
words.meaning: A worker is judged by the quality of his work.

words.word: A young idler, an old beggar.
words.urdu: جوانی میں آوارہ، بڑھاپے میں فقیر
words.meaning: Idle youth leads to a poor old age.

words.word: Absence sharpens love.
words.urdu: جدائی عشق کی آگ کو بھڑکا دیتی ہے
words.meaning: Separation makes love stronger.

words.word: Actions speak louder than words.
words.urdu: اصلیت کو افعال ہی ظاہر کر سکتے ہیں
words.meaning: What you do matters more than what you say.

words.word: Adversity is the best judge of a friend and a foe.
words.urdu: وقت پڑنے پر دوست اور دشمن کی پہچان ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: Hard times reveal true friends.

words.word: Adversity makes a man wise, not rich.
words.urdu: بپتا سے گیان بڑے نہ دھن
words.meaning: Hardship teaches wisdom, not wealth.

words.word: After a storm comes a calm.
words.urdu: طوفان کے بعد سکون
words.meaning: Difficult times are followed by peace.

words.word: All doors are open to courtesy.
words.urdu: اخلاق کو ہر جگہ خوش آمدید کہا جاتا ہے
words.meaning: Good manners open every door.

words.word: All that glitters is not gold.
words.urdu: ہر چمکتی ہوئی چیز سونا نہیں ہوتی
words.meaning: What looks attractive may not be valuable.

words.word: All's well that ends well.
words.urdu: انتھ بھلا تو سب بھلا
words.meaning: A good ending makes all the trouble worthwhile.

words.word: An empty vessel makes much noise.
words.urdu: تھوتھا چنا باجے گھنا
words.meaning: Those who know least talk the most.

words.word: An idle man tempts the devil.
words.urdu: بیکار آدمی خود شیطان کو بلاتا ہے
words.meaning: Idle people are easily led into mischief.

words.word: As long as there is life there is hope.
words.urdu: جب تک سانس تب تک آس
words.meaning: Never lose hope while you are alive.

words.word: As you sow, so shall you reap.
words.urdu: جیسا بوؤگے ویسا کاٹوگے
words.meaning: You face the results of your own actions.

words.word: Barking dogs seldom bite.
words.urdu: جو گرجتے ہیں وہ برستے نہیں
words.meaning: Those who threaten most usually do least harm.

words.word: Beauty requires no paint.
words.urdu: نہیں محتاج زیور کا جسے خوبی خدا نے دی
words.meaning: Real beauty needs no decoration.

words.word: Better alone than in a bad company.
words.urdu: بری صحبت سے اکیلا رہنا اچھا
words.meaning: Being alone is better than bad company.

words.word: Better late than never.
words.urdu: دیر آید درست آید
words.meaning: Doing something late is better than not doing it at all.

words.word: Birds of a feather flock together.
words.urdu: چور چور مسیرے بھائی
words.meaning: Similar people tend to stay together.

words.word: Blood is thicker than water.
words.urdu: اپنا اپنا غیر غیر
words.meaning: Family ties are stronger than other relationships.

words.word: Brevity is the soul of wit.
words.urdu: اختصار ظرافت کی جان ہے
words.meaning: Short and clear speech is the essence of wisdom.

words.word: By perseverance the snail reached the ark.
words.urdu: استقلال بڑی چیز ہے
words.meaning: Steady persistence achieves great things.

words.word: Care killed the cat.
words.urdu: فکر بری بلا
words.meaning: Excessive worry can destroy a person.

words.word: Catch the bear before you sell his skin.
words.urdu: خیالی پلاؤ مت پکاؤ
words.meaning: Do not count on something before you actually have it.

words.word: Caution is the parent of safety.
words.urdu: سلامتی کے لیے احتیاط ضروری ہے
words.meaning: Carefulness brings safety.

words.word: Charity begins at home.
words.urdu: اول خویش بعد درویش
words.meaning: Help your own family before helping others.

words.word: Cheats never prosper.
words.urdu: دھوکے کبھی پھلتے پھولتے نہیں دیکھے گئے
words.meaning: Dishonest people do not succeed in the end.

words.word: Circumstance alters cases.
words.urdu: حالات سے معاملات بدل جاتے ہیں
words.meaning: Circumstances change the way a matter is judged.

words.word: Cleanliness is next to godliness.
words.urdu: صفائی پارسائی سے دوسرے درجے پر ہے
words.meaning: Cleanliness is almost as important as virtue.

words.word: Clemency is the remedy of cruelty.
words.urdu: ظلم کا علاج رحمدلی بھی ہے
words.meaning: Mercy is the cure for cruelty.

words.word: Common danger produces agreement.
words.urdu: مصیبت ایک کر دیتی ہے
words.meaning: Shared danger unites people.

words.word: Comparisons are odious.
words.urdu: مقابلہ ناگوار ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Comparisons are unpleasant.

words.word: Confidence begets confidence.
words.urdu: اعتبار سے عموماً اعتبار پیدا ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Trust creates trust.

words.word: Constant dropping wears away the stone.
words.urdu: روز کے ٹپکے سے پتھر بھی گھس جاتا ہے
words.meaning: Small persistent efforts achieve great results.

words.word: Content is better than riches.
words.urdu: قناعت سے بڑھ کر کوئی دولت نہیں
words.meaning: Contentment is greater than wealth.

words.word: Cut your coat according to your cloth.
words.urdu: جتنی چادر ہو اتنا پیر پھیلاؤ
words.meaning: Spend only as much as you can afford.

words.word: Diamond cuts diamond.
words.urdu: لوہا لوہے کو کاٹتا ہے
words.meaning: A strong opponent needs a strong match.

words.word: Do good, have good.
words.urdu: کر بھلا ہو بھلا
words.meaning: Good deeds bring good results.

words.word: Do not burn your house to frighten away the mice.
words.urdu: تھوڑے فائدے کے لیے زیادہ نقصان کرنا
words.meaning: Do not cause great loss for a small gain.

words.word: Do not count your chickens before they are hatched.
words.urdu: آئندہ کے غیر یقینی واقعے پر بہت زیادہ انحصار کر لینا
words.meaning: Do not assume success before it actually happens.

words.word: Do not leave today's work for tomorrow.
words.urdu: آج کا کام کل پر مت چھوڑو
words.meaning: Do not delay what can be done now.

words.word: Do not put all your eggs in one basket.
words.urdu: سارے انڈے ایک ہی ٹوکری میں مت رکھو
words.meaning: Do not risk everything on a single plan.

words.word: Each moment has its own charm.
words.urdu: وقت وقت کا راگ اچھا ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Every time and situation has its own value.

words.word: Even walls have ears.
words.urdu: دیواروں کے بھی کان ہوتے ہیں
words.meaning: Someone may be listening secretly.

words.word: Every flow will have an ebb.
words.urdu: ہر کمال کا زوال ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Every high is followed by a low.

words.word: Everything is fair in love and war.
words.urdu: محبت اور جنگ میں ہر چیز جائز ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: In love and war any trick may be allowed.

words.word: Experience is the greatest teacher.
words.urdu: تجربہ سب سے بڑا استاد ہے
words.meaning: We learn most from our own experience.

words.word: Failure teaches more than success.
words.urdu: انسان فتح سے نہیں بلکہ شکست سے بہت کچھ سیکھتا ہے
words.meaning: People learn more from failure than from success.

words.word: Forbidden fruit is sweetest.
words.urdu: چوری کا گڑ میٹھا لگتا ہے
words.meaning: What is forbidden seems most attractive.

words.word: Forewarned is forearmed.
words.urdu: خطرے سے آگاہی ہو تو انسان مقابلے کے لیے تیار رہتا ہے
words.meaning: Knowing a danger in advance lets you prepare for it.

words.word: Forgive that you may be forgiven.
words.urdu: دوسروں کو معاف کرو تاکہ تمہیں بھی معافی مل جائے
words.meaning: Forgive others so you too may be forgiven.

words.word: Fortune favours the brave.
words.urdu: قسمت بہادر آدمی کی کنیز ہے
words.meaning: Luck favours those who act boldly.

words.word: Fortune knocks at least once at every man's gate.
words.urdu: ایک دفعہ سب کے دن پھرتے ہیں
words.meaning: Every person gets a chance at least once in life.

words.word: Fortune turns like a mill-wheel.
words.urdu: قسمت کا چکر کبھی اوپر کبھی نیچے
words.meaning: Luck rises and falls.

words.word: Fortunes change suddenly.
words.urdu: دن پھرتے دیر نہیں لگتی
words.meaning: Luck can change overnight.

words.word: Give a loan and gain an enemy.
words.urdu: ادھار دیجئے دشمنی لیجئے
words.meaning: Lending money can turn friends into enemies.

words.word: God helps those who help themselves.
words.urdu: ہمت مرداں مدد خدا
words.meaning: God helps people who make their own effort.

words.word: Good health is a thousand blessings.
words.urdu: تندرستی ہزار نعمت ہے
words.meaning: Health is the greatest blessing.

words.word: Great boast, little roast.
words.urdu: اونچی دوکان پھیکا پکوان
words.meaning: Big claims but poor results.

words.word: Great talkers are little doers.
words.urdu: باتوں چکنے کاموں خوار
words.meaning: Those who talk much usually do little.

words.word: Greed is a curse.
words.urdu: لالچ بری بلا ہے
words.meaning: Greed brings ruin.

words.word: Grief divided is made lighter.
words.urdu: بانٹ کھانے سے رنج ہلکا ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Sharing sorrow makes it easier to bear.

words.word: Habit is second nature.
words.urdu: عادت خصلت ہو جاتی ہے
words.meaning: A habit becomes part of your nature.

words.word: Half a loaf is better than no bread.
words.urdu: نہ ہونے سے آدھی بھلی
words.meaning: A small share is better than having nothing.

words.word: Handsome is that handsome does.
words.urdu: کام پیارا ہے جام پیارا نہیں
words.meaning: Goodness shows in actions, not in appearance.

words.word: Hard words break no bones.
words.urdu: سخت الفاظ کسی کو کیا نقصان پہنچا سکتے ہیں
words.meaning: Harsh words do no real physical harm.

words.word: Haste makes waste.
words.urdu: جلدی کا کام شیطان کا
words.meaning: Rushing causes mistakes and loss.

words.word: He is wise who looks ahead.
words.urdu: عقلمند کل کی فکر کرتا ہے
words.meaning: Wise people think about the future.

words.word: He labours in vain who tries to please all.
words.urdu: سب کو خوش کرنا ناممکن ہے
words.meaning: You cannot please everyone.

words.word: He preaches best who lives best.
words.urdu: مثال سے جو اثر ہوتا ہے وہ وعظ سے نہیں ہو سکتا
words.meaning: Example teaches better than preaching.

words.word: He who digs a pit for others falls into it.
words.urdu: جو کسی کے لیے گڑھا کھودتا ہے خود ہی اس میں گرتا ہے
words.meaning: Those who scheme against others get caught themselves.

words.word: He who suffers, conquers.
words.urdu: جو تکلیف اٹھا سکتا ہے فتح اسی کو نصیب ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: Patience through hardship brings victory.

words.word: Health is better than wealth.
words.urdu: ایک تندرستی ہزار نعمت
words.meaning: Good health is worth more than money.

words.word: Hear the other side also.
words.urdu: بات کے دونوں پہلوؤں پر غور کرو
words.meaning: Listen to both sides before judging.

words.word: Hearsay is half lies.
words.urdu: سنی سنائی بات آدھا جھوٹ
words.meaning: Rumours are usually half false.

words.word: His deeds belie his words.
words.urdu: فعل دیگر قول دیگر
words.meaning: His actions contradict his words.

words.word: Honesty is the best policy.
words.urdu: ایمانداری بہترین حکمت عملی ہے
words.meaning: Being honest is always the wisest choice.

words.word: In Rome do as the Romans do.
words.urdu: جیسا دیس ویسا بھیس
words.meaning: Follow the customs of the place you are in.

words.word: It is no use crying over spilled milk.
words.urdu: اب پچھتائے کیا جب چڑیا چگ گئی کھیت
words.meaning: Do not regret what cannot be undone.

words.word: It is too good to be true.
words.urdu: اچھی خبر جس پر یقین نہ آئے
words.meaning: So good that it seems unreal.

words.word: It takes all sorts to make the world.
words.urdu: اس دنیا میں ہر طرح کے لوگ رہتے ہیں
words.meaning: The world is made of all kinds of people.

words.word: It takes two to make a quarrel.
words.urdu: تالی ایک ہاتھ سے نہیں بجتی
words.meaning: A quarrel needs both sides.

words.word: Keep friends close but keep enemies closer.
words.urdu: دوستوں کو قریب لیکن دشمنوں کو قریب تر رکھو
words.meaning: Watch your enemies closely to stay safe.

words.word: Kill not the goose that lays the golden eggs.
words.urdu: سونے کا انڈہ دینے والی مرغی کو حلال کرنا بیوقوفی ہے
words.meaning: Do not destroy the source of your wealth.

words.word: Kings have long arms.
words.urdu: بادشاہوں کے اختیارات و طاقت بہت وسیع ہوتے ہیں
words.meaning: Rulers have far-reaching power.

words.word: Life is not a bed of roses.
words.urdu: زندگی پھولوں کی سیج نہیں
words.meaning: Life has hardships as well as joys.

words.word: Look before you leap.
words.urdu: پہلے تولو پھر بولو
words.meaning: Think carefully before you act.

words.word: Lost time is never found again.
words.urdu: گیا وقت پھر ہاتھ نہیں آتا
words.meaning: Wasted time can never be recovered.

words.word: Love conquers all things.
words.urdu: محبت تمام مشکلات پر غلبہ پا لیتی ہے
words.meaning: Love overcomes every obstacle.

words.word: Love is blind.
words.urdu: محبت اندھی ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: Love ignores the faults of the loved one.

words.word: Love me, love my dog.
words.urdu: مجھ سے محبت کرنی ہے تو میری ہر چیز سے محبت کرنی پڑے گی
words.meaning: If you love someone, accept everything about them.

words.word: Lying is weakness; truth is strength.
words.urdu: جھوٹ بولنا کمزوری ہے اور سچ صحت کی علامت
words.meaning: Lies weaken a person; truth strengthens him.

words.word: Make hay while the sun shines.
words.urdu: بہتی گنگا میں ہاتھ دھولو
words.meaning: Use the opportunity while it lasts.

words.word: Man proposes, God disposes.
words.urdu: واہ رے قسمت کے ولیا پکائی تھی کھیر ہوگیا دلیا
words.meaning: Humans plan, but fate decides the outcome.

words.word: Manners maketh man.
words.urdu: با ادب ہو کر بزرگ بنے
words.meaning: Good manners make a person respected.

words.word: Many a little makes a mickle.
words.urdu: بوند بوند سے گھڑا بھرتا ہے
words.meaning: Small savings add up to a large amount.

words.word: Many hands make light work.
words.urdu: بہت سے کرنے والے ہوں تو کام جلد ہو جاتا ہے
words.meaning: A task is easier when many people help.

words.word: Many men, many minds.
words.urdu: جتنے لوگ اتنے آراء
words.meaning: Different people have different views.

words.word: Many words hurt more than swords.
words.urdu: زبان کا گھاؤ تلوار سے بھی بڑھ کر ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Words can hurt more than weapons.

words.word: Marry in haste, repent at leisure.
words.urdu: جلدی کا نتیجہ ندامت ہے
words.meaning: Hasty decisions bring later regret.

words.word: Meekness is not weakness.
words.urdu: حلیم طبع ہونا کمزوری نہیں
words.meaning: Gentleness is not a sign of weakness.

words.word: Mercy begets mercy.
words.urdu: رحم سے رحم پیدا ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Showing kindness brings kindness.

words.word: Might is not always right.
words.urdu: جس کی لاٹھی ہو ہمیشہ اس کی بھینس نہیں ہوتی
words.meaning: Power does not always decide what is right.

words.word: Might is right.
words.urdu: جس کی لاتھی اس کی بھینس
words.meaning: The powerful can force their will on others.

words.word: Mildness governs better than anger.
words.urdu: جو کام نرمی سے نکلتا ہے وہ گرمی سے نہیں نکلتا
words.meaning: Gentleness achieves what anger cannot.

words.word: Mind your own business.
words.urdu: اپنے کام سے کام رکھو
words.meaning: Do not interfere in other people's affairs.

words.word: Misfortunes never come singly.
words.urdu: مصیبت کبھی تنہا نہیں آتی
words.meaning: Bad things often happen together.

words.word: Moderation is a treasure.
words.urdu: میانہ روی بڑی دولت ہے
words.meaning: Moderation is a great virtue.

words.word: Money borrowed is soon sorrowed.
words.urdu: قرض جلد ہی باعث تکلیف بن جاتا ہے
words.meaning: Borrowing money soon brings worry.

words.word: Money is a good servant but a bad master.
words.urdu: زر خدمتگار اچھا لیکن آقا برا
words.meaning: Use money wisely; do not let it control you.

words.word: Money makes money.
words.urdu: روپیہ کو روپیہ کھینچتا ہے
words.meaning: Wealth attracts more wealth.

words.word: Money makes the man.
words.urdu: آدمی کی قدر روپے سے ہوتی ہے
words.meaning: People are judged by their wealth.

words.word: Money makes the mare go.
words.urdu: دام بنائے کام
words.meaning: Money can get almost anything done.

words.word: Necessity is the mother of invention.
words.urdu: ضرورت ایجاد کی ماں ہے
words.meaning: Need drives people to create solutions.

words.word: Never look a gift horse in the mouth.
words.urdu: مفت کی گائے کے دانت کون دیکھتا ہے
words.meaning: Do not criticize a gift you receive.

words.word: Never meet trouble halfway.
words.urdu: مصیبت کے استقبال کے لیے تیار نہ رہو
words.meaning: Do not worry about trouble before it comes.

words.word: No man can serve two masters.
words.urdu: ایک میان میں دو تلواریں نہیں سماتیں
words.meaning: You cannot serve two conflicting masters.

words.word: No one is born without faults.
words.urdu: عیب سے کوئی پاک نہیں
words.meaning: Everyone has faults.

words.word: No pains, no gains.
words.urdu: سیوہ بن میوہ نہیں
words.meaning: You cannot get results without effort.

words.word: Nothing comes amiss to a hungry man.
words.urdu: بھوکے کو سوکھی بھی چپڑی کے برابر
words.meaning: A hungry person is grateful for any food.

words.word: Nothing comes without a price.
words.urdu: کام بن دام نہیں
words.meaning: Everything good must be earned or paid for.

words.word: One lie leads to another.
words.urdu: جھوٹ کی انتہا نہیں
words.meaning: One lie forces you to tell more lies.

words.word: One nail drives out another.
words.urdu: کانٹے سے کانٹا نکلتا ہے
words.meaning: One problem is removed by another.

words.word: One post and a hundred candidates.
words.urdu: ایک انار سو بیمار
words.meaning: Too many applicants for a single position.

words.word: Out of sight, out of mind.
words.urdu: آنکھ اوجھل پہاڑ اوجھل
words.meaning: You forget what you do not see.

words.word: Practice makes a man perfect.
words.urdu: مشق انسان کو کامل بنا دیتی ہے
words.meaning: Regular practice makes you perfect.

words.word: Prevention is better than cure.
words.urdu: پرہیز علاج سے بہتر ہے
words.meaning: It is better to avoid a problem than to fix it.

words.word: Pride hath a fall.
words.urdu: غرور کا سر نیچا
words.meaning: Pride leads to downfall.

words.word: Punctuality is the soul of business.
words.urdu: پابندی وقت کاروبار کی جان ہے
words.meaning: Being on time is essential to success.

words.word: Riches have wings.
words.urdu: مایا دل کی چھایا
words.meaning: Wealth can disappear quickly.

words.word: Rome was not built in a day.
words.urdu: ہتھیلی پر سرسوں نہیں جمتی
words.meaning: Great tasks take time and patience.

words.word: Seeing is believing.
words.urdu: سنی سنائی بات کا اعتبار نہیں ہوتا
words.meaning: You believe what you see yourself.

words.word: Self-praise is no recommendation.
words.urdu: اپنے منہ میاں مٹھو بننا
words.meaning: Praising yourself proves nothing.

words.word: Silence is half consent.
words.urdu: خاموشی نیم رضا
words.meaning: Staying silent may mean you agree.

words.word: Slow and steady wins the race.
words.urdu: سہج پکے سو میٹھا ہو
words.meaning: Steady, patient effort beats careless haste.

words.word: Society moulds a man.
words.urdu: خربوزے کو دیکھ کر خربوزہ رنگ پکڑتا ہے
words.meaning: People take on the character of their surroundings.

words.word: Something is better than nothing.
words.urdu: بھاگتے چور کی لنگوٹی ہی سہی
words.meaning: Having a little is better than having nothing.

words.word: Strike while the iron is hot.
words.urdu: بہتے دریا میں ہاتھ دھونا
words.meaning: Act at the right moment.

words.word: Tastes differ.
words.urdu: سب کو ایک ہی چیز نہیں بھاتی
words.meaning: Different people like different things.

words.word: Taxes are the sinews of the state.
words.urdu: لگان کے بغیر سلطنت کا کام نہیں چل سکتا
words.meaning: Without taxes a state cannot function.

words.word: Teaching others teaches yourself.
words.urdu: علم دوسروں کو دینے سے بڑھتا ہے
words.meaning: Teaching others increases your own knowledge.

words.word: The best things are hard to come by.
words.urdu: بہترین چیزیں مشکل سے دستیاب ہوتی ہیں
words.meaning: Valuable things are not easy to obtain.

words.word: The boughs that bear most hang lowest.
words.urdu: جتنا پھلے اتنا جھکے
words.meaning: The most accomplished people are the humblest.

words.word: The child is the father of the man.
words.urdu: چھوٹوں سے بڑے ہوتے آئے
words.meaning: Childhood shapes the adult.

words.word: The early bird catches the worm.
words.urdu: پہلے مارے سو میری
words.meaning: Acting early brings success.

words.word: The end crowns the work.
words.urdu: کام کی قیمت انجام سے ہے
words.meaning: The result shows the quality of the work.

words.word: The end makes all equal.
words.urdu: موت کے آگے سب برابر
words.meaning: Death makes everyone equal.

words.word: The eye is the mirror of the soul.
words.urdu: آنکھ گویا ضمیر کا آئینہ ہے
words.meaning: The eyes reveal a person's true feelings.

words.word: The face is the index of the mind.
words.urdu: دل کا حال چہرے سے عیاں ہو جاتا ہے
words.meaning: The face reveals what is in the mind.

words.word: The grass is always greener on the other side.
words.urdu: دور کے ڈھول سہانے
words.meaning: Other people's situations always seem better.

words.word: The guilty are always afraid.
words.urdu: مجرم کو ہر وقت کھٹکا لگا رہتا ہے
words.meaning: The guilty live in constant fear.

words.word: The poor man's voice is never heard.
words.urdu: نقار خانے میں طوطی کی صدا کون سنتا ہے
words.meaning: The weak are not listened to.

words.word: The truth is bitter.
words.urdu: سچی بات ہمیشہ کڑوی لگتی ہے
words.meaning: The truth is often hard to accept.

words.word: There is a time for everything.
words.urdu: ہر کام کا وقت مقرر ہے
words.meaning: Everything should be done at the right time.

words.word: There is more to it than meets the eye.
words.urdu: دال میں کالا
words.meaning: The situation is more complex than it appears.

words.word: There is no rose without a thorn.
words.urdu: جہاں پھول وہاں کانٹا
words.meaning: Every good thing has some drawback.

words.word: Time and tide wait for none.
words.urdu: وقت اور موت کسی کا انتظار نہیں کرتی
words.meaning: Time waits for no one; act in time.

words.word: Time is the greatest healer.
words.urdu: وقت سب سے بڑا مرہم ہے
words.meaning: Pain and grief fade with time.

words.word: Time waits for no one.
words.urdu: وقت کسی کا انتظار نہیں کرتا
words.meaning: Do not waste time; it never stops.

words.word: Too much familiarity breeds contempt.
words.urdu: قدر کھو دیتا ہے روز کا آنا جانا
words.meaning: Being too familiar reduces respect.

words.word: Truth fears no examination.
words.urdu: سانچ کو آنچ نہیں
words.meaning: Truth can stand any test.

words.word: Two heads are better than one.
words.urdu: دو کی عقل ایک سے بڑی
words.meaning: Two people think better than one.

words.word: Two wrongs do not make a right.
words.urdu: دو غلطیاں مل کر درست نہیں ہو جاتیں
words.meaning: Revenge does not fix a wrong.

words.word: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
words.urdu: کوٹھی والا روئے چھپر والا سوئے
words.meaning: Great power brings great worry.

words.word: Union is strength.
words.urdu: اتفاق میں برکت ہے
words.meaning: Working together makes people strong.

words.word: What is violent is not lasting.
words.urdu: تشدد لازمی طور پر عارضی ہوتا ہے
words.meaning: Violence and force do not last.

words.word: When the great quarrel, the poor suffer.
words.urdu: چنوں کے ساتھ گھن بھی پس جاتا ہے
words.meaning: The common people suffer from the disputes of the powerful.

words.word: Where there is a will, there is a way.
words.urdu: جہاں چاہ وہاں راہ
words.meaning: Strong determination finds a way to succeed.

words.word: You cannot get blood out of a stone.
words.urdu: پتھر میں سے تیل نہیں نکلتا
words.meaning: You cannot get something from someone who has none.

words.word: You cannot have your cake and eat it too.
words.urdu: سانپ بھی مر جائے، لاٹھی بھی نہ ٹوٹے
words.meaning: You cannot enjoy two opposite benefits at once.

words.word: You never know till you have tried.
words.urdu: آدمی راہ پڑا یا باہ پڑا جانیے
words.meaning: You cannot know your ability without trying.

words.word: Youth and white paper take any impression.
words.urdu: نرم کونپل ہے جدھر چاہو موڑ لو
words.meaning: Young minds are easily shaped.

words.word: Youth will have its swing.
words.urdu: جوانی دیوانی
words.meaning: Youth is a time of high spirits.

words.word: Zeal without knowledge is a runaway horse.
words.urdu: علم کے بغیر جوش بے لگام گھوڑے کی مانند ہے
words.meaning: Enthusiasm without knowledge is dangerous.
